source_read: https://www.pingpongdimsum.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Ping_Pong_Allergen_Matrix_Free_From_Menus_100625.pdf (linked as 'Allergen Matrix' from https://www.pingpongdimsum.com/menus/; one GET after robots.txt check with robots_rfc: 'User-agent: *' Disallow empty, Crawl-delay 10 honoured; 23 pages, 13.1 MB, sha256 9319d30b434591293252f89a42cef4094e29aa926a0b9070e432984c504ad738; matrix page titled 'Summer 2025 Allergen List', 'June 2025', 'Last updated on 08/06/2025'). Nutrition PDF re-downloaded the same way (sha256 f4b71b8f52921c13d1f9fd5b80aaca93042401b75875c1e58d7b1ac5c86c8090) and the unchanged script reproduced the committed items.csv byte for byte before the allergen code was added.
notes: All 39 published items now have an allergens.csv row copied from the chain's own matrix (page 1: one row per dish, a printed 'x' under each allergen; columns 4-17 are the 14 UK allergens, columns 18-33 are 'Additional allergens & Ingredient' flags (Onion, Garlic, Gluten, Seafood, Shellfish, Wheat, MSG ...) that are not among the 14 and are not published). Read three ways that agree: (1) the text layer with pdftotext -bbox, each 'x' placed in its column by x position against the printed column numbers 4-33 (all 567 marks); (2) pixel sampling of every cell of a 200 dpi render, grid lines detected from the image (61 rows x 30 columns = 1,830 cells: 0 mismatches; two rows beside thick borders needed a narrower sampling band, after which they match; empty cells have 0 dark pixels, marked cells 20 or more); (3) the chain's own 21 'Made without <allergen>' pages inside the same PDF, in which a dish is named exactly when the matrix has no x in that column (1,155 cells over 21 columns incl. the 11 allergen columns celery, cereals, crustacean, eggs, fish, milk, molluscs, mustard, nuts+peanuts, sesame, soya: 0 mismatches). Lupin (no mark anywhere) and sulphur dioxide have no 'Made without' page and were checked by eye. By eye on 170 dpi crops of the rendered page I read all 39 published rows against allergens.csv, all 14 allergen columns: 0 differences. Mark meanings: the matrix legend says "Allergen present in dish is marked with a 'x'" -> contains. The matrix has NO per-dish 'may contain': its only trace statements are the blanket sentence 'all our dishes and drinks may contain traces of nuts, nut oils or egg' and 'fried items have higher risk of cross contamination', so may_contain_published = no (the app then says the guide doesn't say what may be present in traces) and the note on the chain page repeats the blanket sentence. The matrix's 'Cereals' column is the cereals-containing-gluten allergen and is published as gluten with no cereal named (its Wheat column is an ingredient flag, always a subset of Cereals; its Gluten column is always a subset of Cereals; script stops if either is marked without Cereals). Judgement calls for the founder: (a) the 7 published dishes Ping Pong labels gluten-free and marks Cereals (har gau, lucky 8 har gau, mushroom & leek dumpling, flaming phoenix dumpling, spicy chicken dumpling, spicy vegetable dumpling, soy marinated chicken skewer) carry the Cereals mark together with Wheat and 'tested GF' because the pastry is made with wheat starch (page 2 of the PDF: tested to 20 ppm or less of gluten): shown as containing gluten, which is the safe direction, and the chain note says so; (b) the matrix prints no dish codes, but the 'Made without' pages print the chain's code beside each matrix row in the same order (55 coded rows, six desserts have none): 35 published items are tied to their row by identical dish code, and their names differ only by spelling/qualifier, except four where the names differ in wording and only the code ties them (Little Pandas crispy chicken rice bowl 360 = matrix 'Little pandas chicken katsu rice bowl'; honey-soy chicken skewer 288 = 'soy marinated chicken skewer'; spicy chicken Chinese veg dumpling 19 = 'spicy chicken dumpling'; griddled spicy beef gyoza 124 = 'griddled beef dumpling (chilli)'); (c) three items are tied by identical name because the codes are missing or differ in the two documents (apple gyoza 227 vs 277, earl grey macaron 390 vs 388, yuzu macaron no code); mango sorbet by name, no code on either side. Held back for want of an exact row (never guessed; the dish disappears from the app with its numbers): Little Pandas Dim Sum Set Menu and Little Pandas Vegetarian Set Menu (no matrix row), Ice Cream / Sorbet Lemon Sorbet (no matrix row), and Vanilla, Chocolate and Pear (the matrix prints 'vanilla ice cream', 'chocolate ice cream', 'pear sorbet'; the nutrition guide only the flavour, with no code). Restoring any of them needs a founder decision and a new mapping line in ping_pong.py (move it from ALLERGEN_HELD to ALLERGEN_ROW). Eight further dishes are held back for their numbers (unchanged). Policy 3 (allergen row contradicting the dish's own name): none found; the audit reports 0 high / 0 medium after logging one medium flag (Mango Sorbet, named after the 'ice cream / sorbet' heading) in data/audit/reviewed/ping-pong.csv. Not published and not read: the chain's separate 'Made Without Gluten' and 'Vegan' menu PDFs.
